English: The antibacterial and antifungal potential of Geophila obvallata extracts were tested on clinical isolates (Staphylococcus aureus, Klebsiella pneumoniae, Pseudomonas aeruginosa, Escherichia coli, Bacillus subtilis, Streptococcus pyogenes, Cryptococcus neoformans, Candida albicans and Aspergillus fumigatus) using standard techniques.
Luganda: Obusobozi bw’ebikoola by’ekimera kya Geophila obvallata okutta obuwuka bwa bakitiiriya n’obwa fangi bwagezesebwa mu ddwaliro ku buwuka (Staphylococcus aureus, Klebsiella pneumoniae, Pseudomonas aeruginosa, Escherichia coli, Bacillus subtilis, Streptococcus pyogenes, Cryptococcus neoformans, Candida albicans ne Aspergillus fumigatus) okuyita mu bukodyo obw’olugerero.
Yoruba: Agbára atako-batéríà àti atako-fọ́ńgáì Geophila obvallata tí a fà jáde jẹ́ dídánwò lórí àwọn ti apá ìṣègùn (Ààrùn Gbajúmọ̀, Kilẹbusìẹ́lá nimóníà, Sidománá ẹrujinósà, Ẹ́ṣùrékíá Kọlàì Bàsíló Sabatílíìsì, Sirẹtokákọ́sì payọgíìnì, Kiritokákọ́sì neófọ́máànì, Kàǹdídá Ábikà àti Asipagilo fòmígátóòsì) nípa lílo àwọn ète tó rinlẹ̀.
Zulu: Amandla e-antibacterial and antifungal we-Geophila obvallata extracts ahlolwe kuma-isolates omtholampilo (i-Staphylococcus aureus, i-Klebsiella pneumoniae, i-Pseudomonas aeruginosa, i-Escherichia coli, i-Bacillus subtilis, i-Streptococcus pyogenes, i-Cryptococcus neobicans standards, i-Candidas algenus, ne-Candida al.
Hausa: An gwada yiwuwar ƙwayoyin cuta da ƙwayoyin cuta na Geophila obvallata da aka ciro tsantsa a kan warewar asibiti (Staphylococcus aureus da Klebsiella pneumonia da Pseudomonas aeruginosa da Escherichia coli da Bacillus subtilis da Streptococcus pyogenes da Cryptococcus neoformans da Candida albicans da kuma Aspergillus fumigatus ) ta hanyar amfani da daidaitattun hanyoyi.
Northern Sotho: Bokgoni bja twantšho ya dipaktheria le twantšho ya difankase ga ditswaki tša Geophila obvallata go ile gwa dirwa diteko go dipharologanyo tša kalafo (Staphylococcus aureus, Klebsiella pneumoniae, Pseudomonas aeruginosa, Escherichia coli, Bacillus subtilis, Streptococcus pyogenes, Cryptococcus neoformans, Candida albicans le Aspergillus fumigatus) ka go šomiša mekgwa ya tlwaelo.
Amharic: የጂኦፊላ ኦብቫላታ ውጦች ፀረ ባክቴሪያ እና ፀረ ፈንገስ አቅም በክሊኒካዊ ልይቶች (ስታፊሎኮከስ አውሪየስ፣ ክሌብሲየላ ኒዎሞኒያ፣ ሲዮዶሞናስ ኤይሩጊኖሳ፣ ኢሸሪኪያ ኮላይ፣ ባሲለስ ሱብሊቲስ፣ ስትሬፕቶኮከስ ፒዮጄነስ፣ ክሪፕቶኮከስ ኔዮፎርማንስ፣ ካንዲዳ አልቢካንስ እና አስፐርጊለስ ፉሚጋተስ) ላይ መደበኛ ቴክኒኮችን በመጠቀም ተፈትሿል።

Yoruba: Àwọn ìhà ìdínàmọ́ jẹ́ ṣíṣàfihàn láti ní àlékún sii pẹ̀lú àwọn àpòpọ̀ ẹ̀yọ́ ara irúgbìn tí ó ń lé síi.

English: Inhibition was higher in Gram positive bacteria (9.10 to 31.00mm in 40mg/mL concentration) than Gram negative bacteria (3.50 to 27.00mm in 40mg/mL concentration), while the fungal isolates had the least zones of inhibition (2.83 to 25.00mm in 40mg/ml concentration).
Luganda: Obukugire bwali waggulu mu buwuka obumanyiddwa nga Gram positive bacteria (9.10 okutuuka ku 31.00mm mu bungi bw’eddagala bwa 40mg/mL), okusinga obuwuka bwa bakitiiriya (3.50 okutuuka ku 27.00mm in 40mg/mL) ate obuwuka bwa fangi bwe bwalina ebifo ebibukugira okukula ebisinga obutono (2.83 okutuuka ku 25.00mm mu bungi bw’eddagala bwa 40mg/ml).
Yoruba: Ìdínàmọ́ gbé sókè nínú àwọn batéríà tí ó ní Gíráàmù (9.10 sí 31.00mm nínú ẹ̀yọ́ 40mg/mL), ju àwọn Gíráàmù kòkòrò (3.50 sí 27.00mm ní ìkójọpọ̀ 40mg/mL),  nígbà tí àwọn apá fọ́ńgáì ní ó kéré tán ìhà ìdínàmọ́ (2.83 sí 25.00mm in ẹ̀yọ́ 40mg/ml).
Zulu: Ukuvinjelwa kwakuphakeme kumagciwane e-Gram positive (9.10 kuya ku-31.00mm ekugxiliseni okungu-40mg/mL) kunamagciwane e-Gram negative (3.50 kuya ku-27.00mm ekugxilweni kuka-40mg/mL), kuyilapho ama-fungal isolate ayenezindawo ezincane zokuvimbela (2.83 kuya ku-25.00mm ngo-40mg/ml ukugxila).
Hausa: Hani ya kasance mafi girma a cikin ƙwayoyin cutar Gram (tattaruwa 9.10 zuwa 31.00mm a cikin 40mg/mL) fiye da ƙwayoyin cutar Gram (tattaruwa 3.50 zuwa 27.00mm a cikin 40mg/mL), yayin da ƙwayoyin fungal suna da ƙananan yankuna na hanawa (tattaruwa 2.83 zuwa 25.00mm a cikin 40mg/ml).
Northern Sotho: Tšweletšo e bile godingwana ka dipaktheria tša phosethifi ya Kramo (tše 9.10 go fihla go 31.00mm ka go teteano ya 40mg/mL) gho feta paktheria ya nekethifi ya Kramo (tše 3.50 go fihla go fihla go 27.00mm ka go teteano ya 40mg/mL), mola e le gore pharologano ya funkase e bile le seemo se sennyane sa tšweletšo (tše 2.83 go fihla go 25.00mm ka tetetano ya 40mg/ml).
Amharic: የፈንገስ ልይቶች አነስተኛ የእገዳ ዞኖች (ከ2.83 እስከ 25.00ሚ.ሜ በ40ሚ.ግ/ሚ.ሊ መጠን) የነበራቸው ሲሆን እገዳ በግራም አወንታዊ ባክቴሪያዎች (ከ9.10 እስከ 31.00ሚ.ሜ በ40ሚ.ግ/ሚ.ሊ መጠን) ከግራም አሉታዊ ባክቴሪያዎች (ከ3.50 እስከ 27.00ሚ.ሜ በ40ሚ.ግ/ሚ.ሊ መጠን) ከፍ ብሎ ነበር።

English: The minimum inhibitory concentrations (MIC) were lowest in the methanol extract than aqueous extract.
Luganda: Obungi bw’eddagala erikugira enkula y’obuwuka obusookerwako (MIC) bwali wansi mu ddagala eririmu omwenge okusinga eddagala eryalimu amazzi.
Yoruba: Ẹ̀yọ́ ìdínàmọ́ tí ó kéré jù (MIC) kéré nínú ẹ̀yọ́ mẹ́tànọọ̀ ju ẹ̀yọ́ olómi lọ.
Zulu: I-minimum inhibitory concentrations (MIC) ibiphansi kakhulu ekukhishweni kwe-methanol kune-aqueous extract.
Hausa: Matsakaicin adadin tattaruwar (MIC) sun kasance mafi ƙanƙanta a cikin gubar methanol da aka ciro fiye da tsantsa mai ruwa.
Northern Sotho: Palo ya fase fase ya tšweletšo ya diteteano (MIC) e bile fasefase ka go ditswaki tša the methanolo go feta ditswaki tša akhwase.
Amharic: በሜታኖል ውጥ ውስጥ ካሉት ይልቅ በውሃ ውጥ ያሉት ዝቅተኛዎቹ አጋጅ መጠኖች (ዝ.አ.መ) ከሁሉም አነስተኛ ነበሩ።

English: Simillarly, MIC for bacteria (Bacillus subtilis) and fungi (Aspergillus fumigatus) were 0.3 and 2.0mg/mL respectively.
Luganda: Mu ngeri y’emu, MIC y’obuwuka bwa bakitiiriya (Bacillus subtilis) yali ku 0.3 mg/mL ate eya fangi (Aspergillus fumigatus) n’eba ku 2.0 mg/mL.
Yoruba: Bákan náà, MIC fún batéríà (Bàsíló Sabatílíìsì) àti fọ́ńgáì (Asipagilo fòmígátóòsì) jẹ́ 0.3 àti 2.0 mg/mL ní tẹ̀léǹtẹ̀lé.
Zulu: Ngokufanayo, i-MIC yamagciwane (i-Bacillus subtilis) kanye nesikhunta (Aspergillus fumigatus) yayingu-0.3 kanye no-2.0 mg/mL ngokulandelanayo.
Hausa: Hakazalika, MIC na ƙwayoyin cuta (Bacillus subtilis) da fungi (Aspergillus fumigatus) sun kasance 0.3 da 2.0 mg/mL bi-da-bi.
Northern Sotho: Go swana le ka fao, MIC ya dipaktheria (Bacillus subtilis) le fankase (Aspergillus fumigatus) e bile 0.3 le 2.0 mg/mL ka go latelana.
Amharic: በተመሳሳይ ሁኔታ ዝ.አ.መ ለባክቴሪያዎች (ባሲለስ ሱብቲሊስ) እና ለፈንገሶች (አስፐርጊለስ ፉሚጋተስ) በቅደም ተከተል 0.3 እና 2.0 ሚ.ግ/ሚ.ሊ ነበሩ።

English: Methanol extract had higher antibacterial and antifungal effect than aqueous extract.
Luganda: Eddagala eryalimu omwenge lyakola kinene ku kukugira obuwuka bwa bakitiiriya n’obwa fangi okukula okusinga eddagala eryalimu amazzi.
Yoruba: Ẹ̀yọ́ mẹ́tànọọ̀ ní ipa ìtoko-batéríà àti ìtako-fọ́ńgáì púpọ̀ ju ẹ̀yọ́ olómi lọ.
Zulu: Ukukhishwa kwe-methanol kwakunomphumela ophezulu we-antibacterial kanye ne-antifungal kune-aqueous extract.
Hausa: Gubar Methanol tsantsa yana da mafi girma rigakafin ƙwayoyin cuta da antifungal sakamako fiye da mai ƙunshe ruwa tsantsa da aka ciro.
Northern Sotho: Ditswaki tša methanolo di bile le seabe sa twantšho ya dipaktheria le difankase ya godingwana go feta ditswaki tša akhwase.
Amharic: የሜታኖል ውጥ ከውሃ ውጥ የበለጠ የፀረ ባክቴሪያ እና ፀረ ፈንገስ ተጽእኖ ነበረው።

English: Ciprofloxacin, used as control for bacteria had the highest inhibitory activity (33.67mm) when compared to that of the highest concentration of plant extracts administered.
Luganda: Eddagala lya Ciprofloxacin, eryakozesebwa okutangira obuwuka bwa bakitiiriya lye lyasinga okubukugira ennyo (33.67mm) bw’ogeraageranya n’eryo eryalimu eddagala eryaggyibwa mu bimera.
Yoruba: Sipirofosíìnì, tí a lò gẹ́gẹ́ bí ìdèènà fún batéríà ní ó ní ìṣe ìdínàmọ́ tí ó ga jù (33.67mm) nígbà tí a bá ṣàfiwéra rẹ̀ pẹ̀lú ẹ̀yọ́ àwọn irúgbìn tí ṣàgbéyẹ̀wò.
Zulu: I-Ciprofloxacin, esetshenziswa njengokulawula amagciwane yayinomsebenzi ophezulu kakhulu wokuvinjelwa (33.67mm) uma iqhathaniswa nalowo wokugcwala okuphezulu kakhulu kwezitshalo ezikhishwe ezitshalweni ezilawulwayo.
Hausa: Ciprofloxacin, wanda aka yi amfani da shi wajen kulawa da ƙwayoyin cuta yana da mafi girman ayyukan hanawa (33.67mm) idan aka kwatanta da na mafi girman tattarawar tsiro da ake gudanarwa.
Northern Sotho: Ciprofloxacin, ye e šomišwago bjalo ka taolo ya dipaktheria e bile le tšbweletšo ya godimodimo (33.67mm) ge e bapetšwa le ya teteano ya godimodimo ya ditswaki tša dimela ge di dirišitšwe.
Amharic: ከፍተኛው መጠን የዕፅዋት ውጦች ከተደረገባቸው ጋር ሲነጻጸር ለባክቴሪያዎች መቆጣጠሪያ ሆኖ የሚያገለግለው ሲፕሮፍሎክሳሲን ከፍተኛው የማገድ እንቅስቃሴ (33.67ሚ.ሜ) ነበረው።

English: Also, ketoconazole gave the highest zones of inhibition (32.33mm) on the fungi isolates compared to those of the extracts.
Luganda: N’ekirala, eddagala lya ketoconazole lyavaamu ebifo ebikugira obuwuka bwa fangi okukula ebisinga obungi (32.33mm) bw’ogeraageranya n’eryo eryaggyibwa mu bikoola.
Yoruba: Bákan náà, kétókanasoò fi ìhà ìdínàmọ́ tí ó pọ̀ jù (32.33 mm) lórí àwọn ìha ti fọ́ńgáì ju ti àwọn ẹ̀yọ wọ̀nyẹn lọ.
Zulu: Futhi, i-ketoconazole inikeze izindawo eziphakeme kakhulu zokuvimbela (32.33mm) kuma-slates esikhunta uma kuqhathaniswa nalezo ezikhishwe.
Hausa: Haka nan, ketoconazole ya bayar da mafi girman yankuna na hanawa (32.33mm) a kan warewar fungi idan aka kwatanta da waɗanda aka cire.
Northern Sotho: Gape, ketoconazole e fane ka maemo a godimodimo a tšweletšo (32.33mm) go dipharologanyo tša fankase ge go bapetšwa le tša ditswaki.
Amharic: እንዲሁም ከውጦቹ ጋር ሲነጻጸር ኬቶኮናዞል ከፍተኛውን የማገድ ዞኖች (32.33ሚ.ሜ) በፈንገስ ልይቶች ላይ ሰጥቷል።

English: In this study, researchers focused on the plant Geophila obvallata, which is used in West Africa as a treatment for wounds, diarrhoea, hypertension and other illnesses.

English: Though the chemicals produced by the plant have been studied before, the researchers say there was very little information available on how effective they are at preventing bacterial and fungal growth.

Hausa: Ko da yake an yi nazari a kan sinadarai da tsirrai ke samarwa a baya, masu binciken sun ce akwai ƙarancin bayanai a kan yadda suke da tasiri wajen hana kamuwa da ƙwayoyin cuta da kuma fungal.
Northern Sotho: Le ge e le gore dikhemikhale tšeo di tšweleditšwego ke semela se di ile tša nyakišiošwa mo nakong ye e fetilego, banyakišiši ba bolela gore go bile le tshedimošo ye nnyane kudu ye e hwetšagalago mabapi le ka fao di šomago gabotse kudu go thibela go gola ga dipaktheria le difankase.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ በተክሉ የሚመረቱ ኬሚካሎች ከዚህ በፊት ጥናት የተደረገባቸው ቢሆንም የባክቴሪያ እና የፈንገስ እድገትን ለመከላከል ምን ያህል ውጤታማ እንደሆኑ ያለው መረጃ በጣም አነስተኛ ነው ይላሉ ።

English: They therefore wanted to test these plant chemicals against different types of microbes, like bacteria and fungi, to see if they could be used as an effective treatment for infections.
Luganda: Noolwekyo baayagala okugezesa eddagala eriva mu kimera kino ku buwuka obutinniinya obw’ebika eby’enjawulo, gamba nga bakitiiriya ne fangi, okulaba oba nga lisobola ng’eddagala eddala erisobola okukozesebwa okuvumula obuwuka.
Yoruba: Nítorí náà, wọ́n fẹ́ dán àwọn kẹ́míkà irúgbìn wọ̀nyìí wò tako irúfẹ́ àwọn kòkòrò àìfojúrí bí batéríà àti fọ́ńgáì, láti rí i bóyá wọ́n lè jẹ́ lílò fún ìtọ́jú àwọn ààrùn náà.
Zulu: Ngakho-ke babefuna ukuhlola la makhemikhali ezitshalo ngokumelene nezinhlobo ezahlukene zamagciwane, njengebhaktheriya nesikhunta, ukuze babone ukuthi angasetshenziswa yini njengokwelapha okuphumelelayo kwezifo.
Hausa: Don haka, sun so su gwada waɗannan sinadarai na shuka a kan nau’o’in ‘yan halitta daban-daban, kamar ƙwayoyin cuta da fungi, don ganin ko za a iya amfani da su a zaman ingantaccen magani ga cututtuka.
Northern Sotho: Ka fao ba ile ba nyaka go dira diteko tša dikhemikhale tša dimela tše kgahlanong le mehutahuta ya dimaekheroupu, tša go swana le dipaktheria le difankase, go bona ge eba di ka šomišwa bjalo ka kalafo ye e šomago gabotse go diphetetšo.
Amharic: ስለዚህ እነዚህን የዕፅዋት ኬሚካሎች ለኢንፌክሽን ውጤታማ ህክምና ይሆኑ እንደሆን ለማየት እንደ ባክቴሪያ እና ፈንገስ ያሉ የተለያዩ ረቂቅ ተህዋስያን አይነቶች ላይ ለመፈተሽ ፈልገው ነበር።

English: The researchers grew samples of nine common, medically important, bacteria and fungi in the laboratory.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baakuzaayo obuwuka bwa bakitiiriya ne fangi mwenda obusinga okumanyika mu kkeberero ly’eddagala.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèdádìí ṣe ìgbédíde àwọn àpẹẹrẹ batéríà àti fọ́ńgáì mẹ́sàn-án tí ó wọ́pọ̀, tí ó ṣe pàtàkì sí ìlera ní àwọn yàrá àyẹ̀wò.
Zulu: Abacwaningi bakhulise amasampula ayisishiyagalolunye avamile, abalulekile ngokwezokwelapha, amagciwane kanye nesikhunta elabhorethri.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun shuka samfurori na gama-gari guda tara, waɗanda suke da mahimmanci a likitance da ƙwayoyin cuta da kuma fungi a cikin ɗakin gwaje-gwaje.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba ile ba tšweletša disampole tše bohlokwa go kalafo tša dipaktheria le difankase tše senyane tšeo di tlwaelegilego ka laporathoring.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ በላብራቶሪ ውስጥ ዘጠኝ የተለመዱ፣ ለህክምና አስፈላጊ የባክቴሪያዎች እና የፈንገሶች ናሙናዎችን አሳድገዋል።

English: They then extracted chemicals from the dried, crushed leaves of the Geophila plant to test on these microbes.
Luganda: N’oluvannyuma baafuna eddagala okuva mu bikoola by’ekimera kya Geophila ebikalu era ebisekule okusobola okuligesezesereza ku buwuka obutinniinya buno.
Yoruba: Wọ́n wá fa yọ́ àwọn kémíkà jáde lára ewé irúgbìn Geophila gbígbẹ tó ti rún láti dán wọn wò lára àwọn kòkòkò àìfojúrí wọ̀nyìí.
Zulu: Babe sebekhipha amakhemikhali emaqabunga omisiwe, agayiwe esitshalo seGeophila ukuze ahlole lawa magciwane.
Hausa: Daga nan sai suka fitar da sinadarai daga busassu da dakakken ganyen shukar Geophila domin gwada waɗannan ƙwayoyin cuta.
Northern Sotho: Go tloga fao ba ile ba ntšha dikhemikhale go matlakala ao a omeletšego a go šilwa a semela sa Geophila go dira diteko tša dimaekheroupu tše.
Amharic: ከዚያም እነዚህ ረቂቅ ተህዋስያን ላይ ለመፈተሽ ከደረቁ እና ከተፈጩ የጂኦፊላ ተክል ቅጠሎች ኬሚካሎችን አውጥተዋል።

English: For each microbe, plant extracts at 4 different strengths, or “concentrations”, were used, made either with water or a chemical called methanol.
Luganda: Ku buli kawuka akatinniinya, eddagala erivudde mu kimera nga liri ku bunovu, oba “obungi bw’eddagala” bwa mirundi 4 egy’enjawulo lyakozesebwa, nga liteekeddwamu amazzi oba omwenge.
Yoruba: Fún kòkòrò àìfojúrí kọ̀ọ̀kan, àwọn irúgbìn pẹ̀lú agbára 4 ọ̀tọ̀ọ̀tọ̀, tàbí "àkíyèsí", jẹ́ lílò, tí a ṣe pẹ̀lú bóyá omi tàbí kẹ́míkà kan tí à ń pè ní mẹ́tànọọ̀.
Zulu: Ku-microbe ngayinye, okukhishwe kwezitshalo ngamandla ama-4 ahlukene, noma "okugxilwa", kwenziwa ngamanzi noma ikhemikhali ebizwa ngokuthi i-methanol.
Hausa: Ga kowane microbe, an yi amfani da tsantsar tsirrai a ƙarfi daban-daban guda 4, ko “tari”, wanda aka yi da ruwa ko wani sinadari mai suna gubar methanol.
Northern Sotho: Gpu o mongwe le o mongwe, ditswaki tše di tšwago dimeleng ka maatla a 4 ao a fapafapanego, goba “diteteano”, di ile tša šomišwa, tša dirwa e ka ba ka meetse goba ka khemikhale ye e bitšwago methanolo.
Amharic: ለእያንዳንዱ ረቂቅ ተህዋስ በ4 የተለያዩ ጥንካሬዎች እና “መጠኖች” የተክል ውጦች በውሃ ወይም ሜታኖል በሚባል ኬሚካል ጥቅም ላይ ውለዋል።

English: The researchers also separately grew extra groups of each microbe which they tested with distilled water or antibiotic or antifungal drugs.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza era baakuzaayo ebibinja ebirala ebyetengeredde ebya buli kawuka akatinniinya bye baagezesa nga bakozesa amazzi amafumbe oba eddagala eritta obuwuka oba eddagala eritta obuwuka bwa fangi.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí náà tún gbé àwọn ọ̀wọ ọ̀tọ̀ àwọn kòkòrò àìfojúrí kọ̀ọ̀kan dìde láyè ọ̀tọ̀ léyìí tí wọ́n dánwò pẹ̀lú omi tí kò lábàwọ́n tàbí àwọn oògùn apakòkòkò tàbí atako-fọ́ńgái.
Zulu: Abacwaningi baphinde bakhulisa ngokwehlukana amaqembu engeziwe egciwane ngalinye abawahlola ngamanzi acwengekile noma ama-antibiotic noma izidakamizwa ze-antifungal.
Hausa: Masu binciken kuma sun shuka ƙarin rukunoni na kowane ƙwayoyin cuta daban-daban waɗanda suka gwada da ruwa mai narkewa ko ƙwayoyin cuta ko magungunan fungi.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši gape ba ile ba bjala dihlopha tša tlaleletšo tša maekheropu o mongwe le o mongwe tšeo ba ilego ba di dira diteko ka meetse a go tistilwa goba ka anthipayothiki goba ka diokobatši tša twantšho ya fankase.
Amharic: በተጨማሪም ተመራማሪዎቹ በተጣራ ውሃ ወይም ፀረ ተህዋስያን ወይም ፀረ ፈንገስ መድሃኒቶች የሞከሩትን የእያንዳንዱን ረቂቅ ተህዋስ ተጨማሪ ቡድኖች ለየብቻ አሳድገዋል።

English: These samples were “control” experiments, which could be compared to the effects of the plant chemicals.
Luganda: Sampolo zino byali bintu ebigezesebwa “ebifuge” ebyali bisobola okugeraageranyizibwa ku ebyo ebivudde mu ddagala ly’ekimera.
Yoruba: Àwọn àpẹẹrẹ wọ̀nyìí jẹ́ àwọn àyẹ̀wò "tí a dèènà" tí a lè fi wé ipa àwọn kémíkà irúgbìn náà.
Zulu: Lawa masampula ayewukuhlolwa “kokulawula,” okungaqhathaniswa nemiphumela yamakhemikhali ezitshalo.
Hausa: Waɗannan samfurori sun kasance gwaje-gwajen “sarrafawa”, wanda za a iya kwatanta shi da tasirin sinadarai na shuka.
Northern Sotho: Disampole tše di bile ditekolo tša “taolo”, tše di ka bapetšwago le diabe tša dikhemikhale tša dimela.
Amharic: እነዚህ ናሙናዎች ከዕፅዋት ኬሚካሎች ተጽእኖ ጋር ሊወዳደሩ የሚችሉ “የመቆጣጠሪያ” ሙከራዎች ነበሩ።

English: Because scientists know that water shouldn’t affect the growth of the microbes, and that manufactured drugs should affect it, they can use these controls to understand how strong the effects of the plant chemicals really are by comparison.
Luganda: Olw’okuba bannassaayansi bakimanyi nti amazzi tegalina kukosa nkula ya buwuka obutinniinya, ate ng’eddagala erikoleddwa lirina okubukosa, basobola okukozesa obuwuka buno obuli mu kibinja ekifuge okusobola okutegeera obukaali bw’ebiva mu ddagala ly’ebimera okuyita mu kugeraageranya.
Yoruba: Nítorí pé àwọn aṣèwádìí mọ̀ pé omi kò gbọdọ̀ nípa lórí ìdàgbàsóke àwọn kòkòrò àìfojúrí náà, àwọn oògùn tí wọ́n ṣẹ̀dá náà sì gbọdọ̀ nípa lórí rẹ̀, wọ́n lè lo àwọn ìdarí wọ̀nyìí láti ní òye bí ipa ḱmíka irúgbìn ṣe lágbára tó nípa fífiwéra.
Zulu: Ngenxa yokuthi ososayensi bayazi ukuthi amanzi akufanele athinte ukukhula kwamagciwane, nokuthi imithi ekhiqiziwe kufanele ikuthinte, bangasebenzisa lezi zilawuli ukuze baqonde ukuthi inamandla kangakanani imiphumela yamakhemikhali ezitshalo uma iqhathaniswa.
Hausa: Domin masana kimiyya sun san cewa ruwa bai kamata ya shafi ci gaban ‘yan halitta ba, kuma ya kamata magungunan da aka samar su shafe shi, za su iya amfani da waɗannan abubuwan sarrafawa domin fahimtar yadda ainihin tasirin sinadarai na shuka suke ta hanyar kwatanta.
Northern Sotho: Ka gobane bašomi ba tša mahlale ba tseba gore meetse ga se a swanela go ama go gola ga dimaekheroupu, le gore diokobatši tše di dirilwego di swanetše go e ema, ba ka šomiša ditaolo tše go kwešiša gore diabe tša dikhemikhale tša semeladi di maatla bjang ge go bapetšwa.
Amharic: ውሃ በረቂቅ ተህዋስያን እድገት ላይ ተጽእኖ ማድረግ እንደሌለበት እና የተመረቱ መድሃኒቶች ተጽእኖ እንደሚያሳድሩበት ሳይንቲስቶች ስለሚያውቁ የዕፅዋት ኬሚካሎች በንፅፅር ምን ያህል ጠንካራ እንደሆኑ ለመረዳት እነዚህን መቆጣጠሪያዎች መጠቀም ይችላሉ።

English: The researchers found that plant extracts made with methanol reduced the growth of bacteria and fungi, especially at higher concentrations.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baazuula ng’eddagala ly’ekimera eritabuddwamu omwenge lyakendeeza enkula y‘obuwuka bwa bakitiiriya ne fangi, naddala ng’eddagala lingi eriteekeddwamu.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí ṣàwárí pé àwọn ẹ̀yọ́ ara ewé tí a fi mẹ́tánọ́ọ̀ pèsè máa ń mú àdínkù bá ìdàgbàsóke kòkòro batéríà àti fọ́ńgáì, pàápàá jùlọ níbi àkíyèsí gíga.
Zulu: Abacwaningi bathola ukuthi okukhishwe kwezitshalo okwenziwe nge-methanol kunciphisa ukukhula kwamagciwane kanye nesikhunta, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni eziphezulu.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun gano cewa tsiron da aka yi da gubar methanol yana rage ci gaban ƙwayoyin cuta da fungi, musamman ma a mafi girman tattaruwa.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba utollotše gore ditswaki tša dimela ge di hlakantšwe le methanolo di fokoditše go gola ga dipaktheria le difankase, kudukudu ka diteteano tša godingwana.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ በሜታኖል የተሰሩ የዕፅዋት ውጦች የባክቴሪያዎችን እና የፈንገሶችን እድገት በተለይም በከፍተኛ መጠኖች እንደሚቀንሱ ደርሰውበታል።

English: In fact, they found that the plant chemicals were just as effective as the antifungal drugs on 2 of the 3 fungi tested.
Luganda: Eky’amazima kiri nti, mu buwuka bwa fangi 2 ku 3 obwagezesebwa, baazuula ng’eddagala ly’ekimera lyali ku butuukamu bwebumu n’eddagala eritta obuwuka bwa fangi.
Yoruba: Kódà, wọ́ ṣàwárí pé àwọn kẹ́míkà ewé ṣiṣẹ́ gẹ́lé bí àwọn oògùn apakòkòrò fọ́ńgáì lórí 2 nínú àwọn fọ́ńgáì 3 tí wọ́n ti dán an wò.
Zulu: Eqinisweni, bathola ukuthi amakhemikhali esitshalo asebenza kahle njengemithi elwa nesikhunta kwezingu-2 kwezingu-3 ezihloliwe.
Hausa: A gaskiya ma, sun gano cewa sinadarai na shuka suna da tasiri kamar magungunan antifungal a kan 2 daga cikin 3 na fungi da aka gwada.
Northern Sotho: Gabotse, ba hweditše gore dikhemikhale tša dimela di be di šoma gabotse kudu go swana le diokobatši tša twantšho ya difankase go difankase tše 2 go tše 3 tše di dirilwego diteko.
Amharic: እንደ እውነቱ ከሆነ የዕፅዋቶቹ ኬሚካሎች ከተፈተሹት 3 ፈንገሶች መካከል በ2ቱ ላይ እንደ ፀረ ፈንገስ መድሃኒቶቹ ውጤታማ መሆናቸውን ደርሰውበታል።

English: Compared to antibiotics, however, the plant extracts were less effective.
Luganda: Wabula bw’ogeraageranya n’eddagala eritta obuwuka, eddagala ly’ekimera lyali lituukanye kitono.
Yoruba: Bí a bá ṣe àfiwé rẹ̀ sí àwọn oògùn apakòkòrò, àwọn ẹ̀yọ́ ara ọ̀gbìn náà kò ṣiṣẹ́ dáadáa.
Zulu: Nokho, uma kuqhathaniswa nama-antibiotics, izithako zezitshalo zazingasebenzi kahle.
Hausa: Idan aka kwatanta da maganin rigakafi, duk da haka, abubuwan da ake amfani da su na shuka ba su da tasiri.
Northern Sotho: Ge di bapetšwa le dianthipayothiki, le ge go le bjale, ditswaki tša dimela di be di sa šome gabotse.
Amharic: ከፀረ ተህዋስያን መድሃኒቶች ጋር ሲወዳደር ግን የዕፅዋቱ ውጦች ውጤታማነታቸው አነስተኛ ነበር።

English: While the plant extracts did reduce bacterial growth, only one of the bacteria was affected as strongly by plant chemicals as by manufactured antibiotics.
Luganda: Newankubadde ng’eddagala ly’ekimera lyakendeeza okukula kw’obuwuka bwa bakitiiriya, akawuka ka bakitiiriya kamu kokka ke kaakosebwa ennyo eddagala ly’ekimera mu ngeri y’emu nga bwe kakosebwa eddagala eritta obuwuka erikolebwa.
Yoruba: Lákòókò tí àwọn ẹ̀yó ara irúgbìn ń mú àdínkù bá ìdàgbàsókè kòkòrò batéríà, ọ̀kan ṣoṣo nínú àwọn batéríà náà nìkan ni kẹ́míkà irúgbìn nípa lé lórí gẹ́gé bí ìṣẹ̀dá apakòkòkò.
Zulu: Nakuba okukhishwe kwezitshalo kunciphise ukukhula kwamagciwane, linye kuphela ibhaktheriya elathinteka kakhulu ngamakhemikhali ezitshalo njengama-antibiotic akhiqizwayo.
Hausa: Yayin da tsantsar tsirrai ya rage girma na ƙwayar cuta, ɗayan ƙwayoyin cuta ne kawai ya shafa wanda yake da ƙarfi ta hanyar sinadarai na shuka kamar yadda ake yin maganin rigakafi.
Northern Sotho: Le ge e le gore ditswaki tša dimela di ile tša fokotša go gola ga dipaktheria, ke fela paktheria e tee ye e ilego ya angwa kudu ke dikhemikhale tša dimela go swana le ka dianthipayothiki tše di dirilwego.
Amharic: የዕፅዋቱ ውጦች የባክቴሪያዎችን እድገት የሚቀንሱ ቢሆንም እንደተመረቱት ፀረ ተህዋስያን መድሃኒቶች ከባክቴሪያዎቹ አንዱ ላይ ብቻ በዕፅዋት ኬሚካሎች ተጽእኖ አድሮበታል።

English: Plant extracts made with water were also less effective than the methanol extracts and, as expected, distilled water used as a control had no effect on microbe growth.
Luganda: Eddagala ly’ekimera eryatabulwamu amazzi era lyali lituukiridde kitono okusinga eddagala eryatabulwamu omwenge ate era nga bwe kisuubirwa, amazzi amafumbe agaakozesebwa ku kibinja ekifuge tegalina kye gaakola ku nkula y’obuwuka obutinniinya.
Yoruba: Àwọn ẹ̀yọ́ ara ewé tí a fi omi pèsè náà kò ṣiṣẹ́ dára tó ju ti àwọn ẹ̀yọ ara mẹ́tànọọ̀ bákan náà, gẹ́gẹ́ bí a ṣe léro, omi tí kò lábàwọ́n tí a lò láti ṣòdiwọ̀n kò ní ipa kankan lórí ìdàgbàsóke kòkòrò àìfojúrí.
Zulu: Izitshalo zezitshalo ezenziwe ngamanzi nazo bezingasebenzi kahle kunezikhishwe ze-methanol futhi, njengoba bekulindelekile, amanzi acwecwe asetshenziswa njengesilawuli awabanga namphumela ekukhuleni kwamagciwane.
Hausa: Kuma abubuwan da aka shuka da aka yi da ruwa kuma ba su da tasiri fiye da tsantsar gubar methanol, kamar yadda ake tsammani, ruwan da aka yi amfani da shi a matsayin sarrafawa ba shi da wani tasiri ga ci gaban ƙwayoyin cuta.
Northern Sotho: Ditswaki tša dimela tšeo di dirilwego ka meetse le tšonma di be di sa šoma gabotse go feta ditswaki tša methanolo le, ka fao go bego go emetšwe ka gona, meetse a go tistilwa ge a šomišwa bjalo ka taolo ga se a ba le seabe go go gola ga dimaekheroupu.
Amharic: በውሃ የተሰሩ የዕፅዋት ውጦችም ከሜታኖል ውጦች ያነሰ ውጤታማ ነበሩ እና እንደተጠበቀው እንደ መቆጣጠሪያ ጥቅም ላይ የዋለው የተጣራ ውሃ በረቂቅ ተህዋስያን እድገት ላይ ምንም ተጽእኖ አላሳደረም።

English: The researchers said that these results showed that chemicals from the Geophila plant may be a useful tool against drug-resistant microbes, as the chemicals appear to have strong antibacterial and antifungal properties.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baagamba nti ebyazuulibwa bino byalaga nti eddagala eriva mu kimera kya Geophila liyinza okuba ekyokulwanisa eky’omugaso eri obuwuka obutinniinya obugugubira eddagala, kubanga eddagala erikivaamu lirabika okuba nga lirimu obusobozi bwa maanyi obw’okutangira enkula y’obuwuka bwa bakitiiriya ne fangi.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí sọ pé àwọn àbájáde wọ̀nyìí fihàn pé àwọn kẹ́míkà láti inú irúgbìn Geophila lè jẹ́ ohun èò tí ó wúlò fún láti tako àwọn kòkòrò àìfojúrí atakò-oògùn, pẹ̀lú bí kẹ́míkà náà ṣe farahàn láti ní àwọn àbùdá atako-batéríà àti atako-fọ́ńgáì.
Zulu: Abacwaningi bathi le miphumela ibonise ukuthi amakhemikhali esitshalo se-Geophila angase abe ithuluzi eliwusizo lokulwa namagciwane amelana nezidakamizwa, njengoba amakhemikhali abonakala enezici ezinamandla zokulwa namagciwane kanye ne-antifungal.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun ce waɗannan sakamakon sun nuna cewa sinadarai daga shukar Geophila suna iya zama kayan aiki masu amfani ga ƙwayoyin cuta masu jure wa ‘yan halitta, kamar yadda sinadaran suke da ƙarfi na kashe ƙwayoyin cuta da na fungal.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba boletše gore dipoelo tše di laeditše gore dikhemikhale go tšwa go semela sa Geophila e ka ba setlabelo sa mohola kgahlanong le dimaekheupu tša go palela dipokobatši, ka ge dikhemikhale tša tšoina di bonala di na le maatla a diteng tša twantšho ya dipaktheria le difankase.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ እነዚህ ውጤቶች እንደሚያሳዩት ኬሚካሎቹ ጠንካራ የፀረ ባክቴሪያ ወይም የፀረ ፈንገስ ባህሪያት እንዳላቸው ስለሚታይባቸው ከጂኦፊላ ተክል ውስጥ የሚገኙ ኬሚካሎች መድሃኒት ተቋቋሚ ረቂቅ ተህዋስያን ላይ ጠቃሚ መሣሪያ ሊሆኑ እንደሚችሉ ያሳያሉ ብለዋል።

English: They also noted that Geophila may be more effective against certain types of bacteria than others.
Luganda: Baayongerako era ne bagamba nti ekimera kya Geophila lyandiba nga lituukiridde bulungi ku bika bya bakitiiriya ebimu okusinga ku birala.
Yoruba: Wọ́n tún kíyèsí i pé Geophila lè ṣiṣẹ́ síi láti tako irúfẹ́ oríṣìí àwọn kòkòrò betéríà kan ju àwọn yòókù lọ.
Zulu: Baphinde baqaphela ukuthi i-Geophila ingase isebenze kangcono ngokumelene nezinhlobo ezithile zamagciwane kunamanye.
Hausa: Sun kuma lura cewa Geophila na iya zama mafi tasiri a kan wasu nau’o’in ƙwayoyin cuta fiye da sauran.
Northern Sotho: Ba lemogile gape gore Geophila e ka šoma kudu kgahlanong le mehuta ye mengwe ya paktheria go feta tše dingwe.
Amharic: በተጨማሪም ጂኦፊላ የተወሰኑ የባክቴሪያ አይነቶች ላይ ከሌሎች የበለጠ ውጤታማ ሊሆን እንደሚችል ጠቁመዋል።

English: They added that using methanol probably also allowed more plant chemicals to be extracted, and that this might be what made the methanol treatments so successful.
Luganda: Baayongerako era ne bagamba nti okukozesa omwenge kyandiba nga nakyo kyasobozesa eddagala ly’omu kimera eriwerako okuba nga lyaggyibwamu, era nti kino kyandiba nga kye kyaleetera eddagala eryateekebwamu omwenge okuba nga lyakola nnyo.
Yoruba: Wọ́n ṣe àfikún èyí pẹ̀lú ìṣàmúlò métànọọ̀ bóyá ó tún fàyè gba àfàyọ àwọn kẹ́míka àwọn irúgbìn síi, wí pé bóyá èyí lè jẹ́ ohun tí ó mú àwọn ìtọ́jú mẹ́tànọọ̀ yìí ṣe àṣeyọrí tó bẹ́ẹ̀.
Zulu: Bangeze ngokuthi ukusebenzisa i-methanol cishe kuphinde kwavumela amakhemikhali ezitshalo amaningi ukuthi akhishwe, nokuthi lokhu kungaba yikho okwenza ukwelashwa kwe-methanol kuphumelele kangaka.
Hausa: Kuma sun ƙara da cewa yin amfani da gubar methanol mai yiwuwa ya bayar da damar ciro wasu sinadarai na shuka, kuma hakan yana iya zama abin da ya sa magungunan gubar methanol ya yi nasara sosai.
Northern Sotho: Ba tlaleleditše ka gore ge go šomišwa methanolo ka maleba gape go ile gwa dumelela dikhemikhale tša dimela go ntšhwa, le gore se se ka be e le seo se dirilwego gore kalafo ka methanolo e atlege kudu.
Amharic: አክለውም ሜታኖልን መጠቀም ምናልባት ብዙ የዕፅዋት ኬሚካሎች እንዲወጡ ፈቅዷል እና የሜታኖል ህክምናዎችን ውጤታማ ያደረገው ይህ ሊሆን ይችላል ብለዋል።

English: The study was conducted by researchers from Nigeria and adds to what we know about using medicinal plant chemicals to treat drug-resistant microbes.
Luganda: Okunoonyereza kwakolebwa abanoonyereza okuva mu ggwanga lya Nigeria era nga lyongera ku ebyo bye tumanyi ku kukozesa eddagala eriva mu bimera mu kuvumula obuwuka obutinniinya obugugubira eddagala.
Yoruba: Iṣẹ́ ìwádìí yìí jẹ́ ṣíṣe láti ọwọ́ àwọn aṣèwádìí láti orílẹ̀-èdè Nàìjíríà a sì fi kún ohun tí a mọ̀ nípa lílo àwọn kẹ́míkà ewé àgbo láti fi ṣètọ́jú kòkòrò afààrùn sára tó ń tako oogùn.
Zulu: Ucwaningo lwenziwe abacwaningi base-Nigeria futhi lwengeza kulokho esikwaziyo ngokusebenzisa amakhemikhali ezitshalo zokwelapha ukwelapha amagciwane amelana nemithi.
Hausa: Masu bincike daga Nijeriya ne suka gudanar da binciken kuma ƙari ne ga abin da muka sani game da amfani da sinadarai na tsirrai na magani domin magance ‘yan halitta masu jure-magani.
Northern Sotho: Dinyakišišo di dirilwe ke banyakišiši go tšwa ka Nigeria ebile di tsenya letsogo go seo re šetšego re se tseba mabapi le go šomiša dikhemikhale tša semela sa sehlare go alafa dimaekheroupu tša go palela diokobatši.
Amharic: ጥናቱ የተካሄደው ከናይጄሪያ በመጡ ተመራማሪዎች ሲሆን ለመድሃኒትነት የሚውሉ የዕፅዋት ኬሚካሎችን በመጠቀም መድሃኒት ተቋቋሚ ረቂቅ ተህዋስያንን ለማከም የምናውቀው ላይ ይጨምራል።
